GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 7th 6 Lengths 600m 7th 5 Lengths home turn 7th took inside run Straight to run on final 200m # ran on/ready
Jumped Ok , Settled Mid Field 3 Wide With Cover 4 Lengths 600m, came widest from the corner, battled on well enough last 200m but lacked winning dash, visors off first time # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced very wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well sat rail 3l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, battled on well without threatening # even effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 50m had to be shifted out across heels to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, battled on strong # no match 1,2

Jumped Ok , Caught Four Wide No Cover Just off speed 1 Lengths 800m, did not get any closer than 3 Wide middle stages, Ridden Along from the corner, fought the race out strongly last 200m after Wide run # tough run/brave
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three-wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, kept on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1000m became momentarily crowded for room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Pushed fwd & worked to lead on inside by 3/4L early . Held lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Rider dropped whip @ 400m. Pressured & laid out Six Wide @ 250m. Fought on until over-run in last 75m. # Led - no match
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr  dropped her whip near the 400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. got up inside leader turn. battled on well # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: In the early part of the home straight became held up on heels before having to be shifted in across heels to continue into clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (3L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken Five Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & outsprinted Five Wide in last 200m. # One-paced
Jumped Well sat 3l off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4l off all clear, battled on well after Wide run # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Niggled early & raced Worse than midfield Four Wide (4L from lead). Held Ground until pushed out Five Wide @ 500m. Pushed to quicken Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & chased soundly in last 200m. # Wide/tried hard.

Jumped OK. Raced keenly 4th Two Wide (2.5L from lead) early . Held Ground midrace & pushed out 3 Wide (2.5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & back to rail @ 150m. Held ground in last 100m. # Every Chance
